description.en: Ontology module for derived textile durability and use-related indicators. It separates indicators from assessment results, product characteristics, thresholds and quantitative values.

comments.en: This module models interpretive or calculated indicators. It does not treat a raw assessment result, a durability characteristic, a threshold or a quantitative value as an indicator.
